title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 1 Route + Ownership
scope: Add Prop Analytics as an independent NFL market and route owner. Preserve frozen Passing Yards and every existing NFL route. No schedule/provider/prop data in Step 1.

architecture.route_strategy: additive root selector extension plus direct Prop Analytics ownership

acceptance: Prop Analytics appears as a selectable NFL market.
Selecting Prop Analytics renders exactly one V1 route owner.
Cold query NFL -> Prop Analytics resolves to the same owner.
Every non-Prop-Analytics route delegates to frozen V239.
Passing Yards V239 remains reachable after the new wrapper is active.
390/768/1440 Step 1 route surface has no horizontal overflow.
Public production proof passes before Step 1 is declared GREEN + FROZEN.
